cmu_category: Run / Pass / Punt Rec / Extra Pt.(?) / FG(?)
note: Splits by the play_type column proposed in play_type_inventory.csv: rush/kneel -> Run (kneel mapping unconfirmed -- CMU may log it separately); pass_complete/pass_incomplete/pass_intercepted -> Pass; punt_with_return/punt_no_return/punt_blocked -> Punt Rec (CMU's single punt category, per game-1 decode -- unconfirmed whether blocked punts get their own value); field_goal_good/missed/blocked -> no confirmed CMU category yet, field goals were not decoded from game 1 (CMU schema section only lists KO, Pass, Run, Penalty, Punt Rec, Extra Pt.) -- needs a CMU game with a made or missed FG to confirm the category string.
CMU includes kickoffs as rows with NA down/ytg/field_pos (see CLAUDE.md); our kickoff row_type keeps that behavior.
Includes made, missed, and blocked PAT kicks -- CMU's decoded play_result values (Good, etc.) presumably capture the outcome sub-detail, not a separate category.

CLAUDE.md's decoded game-1 category list has no two-point value because game 1 had no two-point tries. 9 tries now observed across games 3,6,7,8,9,11 (see play_type_inventory work) -- need to check CMU's actual sheet for what they call this category before finalizing.

Matches CLAUDE.md's decoded mapping directly. Per the penalty convention CLAUDE.md already decided, CMU drops these rows entirely from their data (no row, no yardage) -- our has_penalty/penalty_yards/penalty_text columns (step 4, not yet built) exist to explain mismatches this causes.
